market_view: SPY ripping +4.71% today but VIX still elevated at 29.56 and up 22% on the 5-day — this is a fear-spike bounce in a risk-off regime, not a regime change. Short put vertical is benefiting from the rally but elevated IV keeps premium inflated against us.

SPY 675/665p.reasoning: Mid cost $1.745 is now 1.26x the $1.38 credit — still below the 1.5x cut threshold of $2.07, but worst-case $2.47 blows through it hard. Short strike is 6.55% OTM and not threatened by today's rally, but VIX at 29.56 (up 11% today itself) means IV is still pumping against us despite favorable underlying movement — the mid is drifting up even as SPY surges, which is the tell.
